title: Public understanding of Adriatic Sea biodiversity
reference: Radoje Laušević, Mirjana Bartula (2024): Public understanding of Adriatic Sea biodiversity. International conference “Adriatic Biodiversity Protection – AdriBioPro2024”. 01-04 October 2024, Kotor, Montenegro. Book of Abstracts. 2024. Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro. 105.
venue: International conference “Adriatic Biodiversity Protection – AdriBioPro2024”. 01-04 October 2024, Kotor, Montenegro. Book of Abstracts
publisher: Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro
description: This paper assesses public understanding of Adriatic Sea biodiversity and protective actions through an online survey conducted on Aquarium Boka’s website in October 2022, with 54 responses collected. The survey focused on: biodiversity terminology, wildlife-related value orientations, perceptions of biodiversity change, knowledge of Adriatic species, views on political actors, aquarium visit expectations and experiences, engagement in environmental organizations, interest in outdoor activities, and follow-up. Socio-demographics showed a higher proportion of females and university-educated respondents compared to personal pooling.
